pins.name: CSB
pins.notes: Chip select. Leave unconnected (pulled HIGH on the board) to use I2C

pins.name: SDO
pins.notes: Address select: LOW = 0x76, HIGH = 0x77. Most boards default to 0x76

otherValues.0x60: This is a BME280: it also measures humidity.

gotchas.text: It measures temperature and pressure only, no humidity. If your code asks for humidity, you need a BME280.
The address is 0x76 with SDO to GND and 0x77 with SDO high. Most GY boards answer at 0x76, while the Adafruit library looks at 0x77 unless you pass 0x76.

sources.title: Bosch BMP280 datasheet
sources.section: I2C interface: address 0x76 when SDO = GND, 0x77 when SDO = VDDIO
